extName.message: Tab Snooze - Save Tabs for Later & Reopen
extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome Web Store and toolbar. Keyword-led for store search (<= 45 chars); brand OneClick Snooze lives in the description.

extDescription.message: Snooze tabs in one click: close now, Chrome reopens later automatically. Save tabs for later & keep your browser clutter-free.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome Web Store (<= 132 chars).

auto_enable.description: Checkbox that turns the automatic snooze mode on or off.

auto_enableDesc.message: While enabled, a background check runs every 15 minutes and snoozes tabs by the rules below.

auto_maxTabs.description: Label for the tab cap setting.

auto_duration.description: Label for how long auto-snoozed tabs stay closed.

auto_help.description: Instruction block explaining how auto snooze works.

auto_helpExcluded.message: Never snoozed: the active tab, pinned tabs, tabs playing audio, and browser pages (chrome://…).

notif_autoSnoozedN.description: Desktop notification when auto snooze closes several tabs. $1 is the tab count.
